integration: Load menu.css, copy .loop-nav with .loop-toggle, transparent .loop-scroll-zone, .loop-panel and seven .loop-link elements from index.html, then load menu.js as a module. No external runtime dependencies.
mobile: Same portrait/landscape responsive rule. Closed trigger flicks between bottom, middle and top docks on either side. Up/down24px advances one vertical level in that direction; inward12px changes side. Intent survives curved paths, pauses and final-release-only sampling. Diagonal flicks can change both axes. Middle dot targets5%/95% viewport width and50% visible viewport height, constrained to keep its56px target inside safe areas. Menu stays opposite and level. While open, one transparent168px-high scroll band spans the menu outer edge through the outlined trigger; pointer/wheel input over links, gap or dot scrolls the same infinite menu. Trigger docking is locked while open.
desktop: Seven source-style dots remain position:fixed at left30px/top50px while the document scrolls; verified with 757px body scrolling and exact unchanged dot bounds.
motion: Drag follows pointer, release decelerates into aligned row. Wheel/trackpad deltas are smoothed and gently aligned without injecting a second inertial tail. New input interrupts motion immediately; wrapping occurs outside clipped window.
accessibility: Native links/button/region; only centered link in tab order; ArrowUp/Down cycle following visual direction; Home/End; Enter; Escape returns focus to trigger. Resizing moves focus out of newly hidden content. Reduced-motion avoids coast and alignment animation. Pinch zoom allowed in touch region. While closed, focus trigger and use ArrowLeft/Right to choose handedness; hidden help documents the gesture. Trigger settling respects reduced motion. Closed ArrowUp/Down steps through top/middle/bottom; ArrowLeft/Right selects side. Open trigger tap still closes, while dragging it scrolls links and suppresses only the accidental trailing click.
